audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Zed/Zed/Skill/Skill/Zed/Skill/Skill while the content layer and the packet levelChart both read Zed/Zed/Zed/Zed/Azir/Zed/Azir — five of seven rows rendering two answers, including level 6 where the full layer said Zed and the content layer said Azir.
audit.why: 51.18% over 1018 games. Emperor's Divide is terrain and stops the Death Mark dash, which is what makes level 6 Azir's row; Zed retakes the first-item row on lethality.
audit.corrected: phases[2],[3],[5] moved to Zed and phases[4],[6] to Azir so both layers match; those five whys rewritten to their new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Zed's ultimate is 'crit-scaling' and 'scales relentlessly with crit items', and called his shadow uptime 'mana-hungry'.
audit.why: enemyKit R: 'repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked' — it scales with the damage he lands, which comes from lethality, not crit. His resource is energy: Living Shadow's passive is 'Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability'; Shadow Slash costs 40 energy.
audit.corrected: whys[5], spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text and late now describe the 3-second mark repeating his damage, lethality items, and energy-limited shadow uptime.

audit.whatIsWrong: No concrete numbers on the interaction that decides the lane: Death Mark's 3-second delay, Living Shadow's 650 throw and 20s cooldown, Shadow Slash's 290 range and 5s, Razor Shuriken's 900 range.
audit.why: ownerKit R is terrain — it stops the Death Mark dash, which is flagged dash. Azir's E is a 22s dash+shield, his only exit once the mark is on. Death Mark makes Zed untargetable during the dash, so the punish is the moment it ends.
audit.corrected: Those numbers now carry the cooldowns field, the Do's/Don'ts bodies, and the level-chart whys; the punish window is stated as the end of the untargetable dash.

audit.why: It is the field that exists to hold cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Death Mark 120s and its 3-second mark, Living Shadow 20s, Shadow Slash 5s, Azir E 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim under 'Shove crashes and ping his every roam' and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under 'Let him shove-and-roam without pings' (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d also described something other than their titles.
audit.why: Each title promises an action the body never explained.
audit.corrected: Five bodies rewritten to their own titles against Zed's real kit.

edits.before: W a soldier behind the wave and farm THROUGH it — your auto range is the soldier's range. Don't poke yet; sand costs mana.
edits.after: Razor Shuriken is 900 range on 6s and costs 75 energy. W behind the wave, farm through the soldier, poke nothing yet.

edits.before: Two soldiers up means a real trade: W-Q the drag-through and step back. The poke is free only when his engage is down.
edits.after: Two soldiers let you drag a Q through him, but Living Shadow lands at 650 and swaps him out. Trade once and step off.

edits.before: E completes the safety net — you now have the shield-dash out. Greedier soldier placements are allowed, not encouraged.
edits.after: E is your shield-dash out, but Shadow Slash is 5s and Living Shadow 20s — he has two ways in and you have one out.

edits.before: Nashor's components arrive and the soldier DPS starts to sting. Drag Qs through Zed on every last-hit he takes.
edits.after: Razor Shuriken reaches 900 through minions and his shadow throws one too. Farm behind the sand and take the chip.

edits.before: Emperor's Divide online — the dive insurance and the insec flip. With R up you win every 2v2 your jungler joins.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide is terrain: it stops the Death Mark dash outright. With R up his level-6 all-in stops being free.

edits.before: Nashor's spike: your soldier poke becomes shred. Shove crashes and rotate — the soldiers siege towers better than any mid.
edits.after: Nashor's lands, but his lethality item makes Death Mark lethal — hold R and Zhonya's for the 3-second mark.

edits.before: Full build Azir is a teamfight: R cuts the fight in half, soldiers melt whoever is on your side of the wall.
edits.after: Full build your wall splits the fight, and soldiers melt him the moment his untargetable dash ends.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Zed drops a shadow behind you, marks you with an untargetable Death Mark dash, and the mark repeats it all 3 seconds later.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Shifting Sands has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Death Mark is 120s at rank 1 and marks you for 3 seconds: spend Zhonya's or E after the mark lands, not before. - Living Shadow is 20s and Shadow Slash 5s — that pair is his way in and out. - E Shifting Sands (22s) has one job: the moment it goes wrong.

edits.before: The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Living Shadow throws to 650 and he swaps to it — park sand on that line so the swap lands him inside your soldier's damage.

edits.before: W behind the wave, Q-drag the soldier through Zed on his last-hit, auto once through the soldier, step back — two-second trades he cannot answer without overextending.
edits.after: Zed clears slowly with a 290-range Shadow Slash, so crash the wave with soldier autos and he either follows or gives up the plate. Ping the second he vanishes.

edits.before: Zed whiffs Death Mark and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide is terrain — it stops the Death Mark dash.

edits.before: That is Zed’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: E is 22s at rank 1 and it is your only exit from the mark.

edits.before: Standing at max soldier range admiring your poke with E on cooldown — that is the engage window every Zed player is waiting for.
edits.after: Living Shadow is 20 seconds of free map movement — lose sight of him without pinging and the mark lands on somebody else.

edits.before: Ahead, siege: crash waves with soldier autos, take every plate, and rotate to river with R held — your wall converts even fights into massacres.
edits.after: Ahead, siege: crash with soldier autos, take plates while Living Shadow's 20 seconds is down, and rotate with R held to wall off his dive.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.
edits.after: Carry through siege — soldiers take plates, and Emperor's Divide is terrain that stops the Death Mark dash before the mark lands.

edits.before: If Zed opens the score, reset expectations and respect Death Mark doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.
edits.after: If Zed opens the score, rush Seeker's Armguard and count Death Mark's 3-second window before you spend anything. After a second, farm at soldier range and hold R for his dive.

edits.before: Zed's crit-scaling execute ultimate keeps this phase even-to-his, since he can still burst through a shield or isolate a target
edits.after: Zed's lethality item makes Death Mark lethal here, and he can still burst through your shield or isolate you off the wave

edits.before: Your first item spikes shove speed and poke range, letting you punish his mana-hungry shadow uptime and force him off you before he's ready to all-in.
edits.after: Your first item spikes shove speed and poke range, letting you punish the gaps when his energy is spent on shadow uptime and force him off before he is ready to all-in.

edits.before: Zed's ultimate execute damage scales relentlessly with crit items and can delete you through a shield in one rotation if he catches you split from your team, keeping this phase his even into fights.
edits.after: Zed's Death Mark repeats a portion of everything he lands in its 3 seconds, and lethality items make that one rotation lethal if he catches you split from your team, keeping this phase his even into fights.

edits.before: Zed's ultimate scales into a real execute threat with crit items and can burst you down in one rotation if he isolates you, so this phase stays contested rather than clearly yours. Play around vision and grouping — force him to engage into your soldiers and wall rather than letting him pick you off alone, and treat Zhonya's or a defensive item as mandatory versus his all-in burst.
edits.after: Zed's Death Mark repeats a portion of all damage he lands in its 3 seconds, and lethality items make that one rotation lethal if he isolates you, so this phase stays contested rather than clearly yours. Play around vision and grouping — force him to engage into your soldiers and wall rather than letting him pick you off alone, and treat Zhonya's as mandatory against his all-in burst.
